verdict.rationale: Finix documents seller onboarding via forms/APIs (finix-docs-4,5,6,9,10) and onboarding notifications/webhooks (finix-docs-29), but nothing in the evidence describes tunable/staged onboarding friction, minimum-to-start-selling flows gated by payout thresholds, or explicit requirements-due states per seller. Missing for 10: documentation of progressive/staged KYC requirements, payout-threshold gating logic, and any 'currently due / eventually due' style seller status object.
